without_skill_failures: No separate NuGet package is added — SAML is built into Duende.IdentityServer
AssertionConsumerServiceUrls uses IndexedEndpoint with Location 'https://crm.contoso.com/saml/acs' and Binding = SamlBinding.HttpPost
AllowedScopes is configured on the SamlServiceProvider (not empty)
Explains that Automatic Key Management RSA keys are auto-wrapped into a self-signed X.509 container
Notes that UseX509Certificate is not required just to enable SAML and is not supported for EC keys (custom ISamlSigningService needed)
States SAML service provider extended properties are validated/stored/returned through ISamlServiceProviderAdmin
States they are not projected onto the runtime SamlServiceProvider returned by ISamlServiceProviderStore, so they can't be used as input to SAML protocol processing
Implements ISamlServiceProviderStore with FindByEntityIdAsync(string entityId, CancellationToken ct)
Implements GetAllSamlServiceProvidersAsync returning IAsyncEnumerable<SamlServiceProvider>
Shows AddSamlServiceProviderStoreCache<T>() for adding HybridCache layer
Explains or shows AllowedScopes as a prerequisite for claims reaching ClaimMappings
Shows how to set DefaultClaimMappings on SamlOptions for global defaults
Explains that SLO uses front-channel logout via iframes (not redirect chains)
Shows SingleLogoutServiceUrls configuration with SamlEndpointType and SamlBinding.HttpRedirect
Mentions that partial logout is normal/expected when some SPs don't respond
Mentions ISamlLogoutSessionStore for distributed/multi-node deployments
The GenerateAsync method receives a NameIdGenerationContext with Subject claims
Returns NameIdGenerationResult.Success with a NameId containing the employee_id value
Handles the missing claim case with NameIdGenerationResult.Failure
Mentions ISamlSigninStateStore for distributed sign-in state persistence
Mentions ISamlLogoutSessionStore for distributed SLO session tracking
States that Standard (add-on), Advanced, or Custom Edition license is required
Mentions that ACS URLs must use HTTP-POST binding (HTTP-Redirect is not supported for ACS)
States that AllowedScopes must contain at least one entry
Explains that invalid SPs are treated as non-existent (returns null from store)
Registers the handler with AddSamlServiceProvider on the AddAuthentication builder
Sets AllowUnsolicitedAuthnResponse = true and also sets IdpInitiatedCallbackUrl (required when unsolicited responses are allowed)
Sets SignInScheme to IdentityServerConstants.ExternalCookieAuthenticationScheme
Callback authenticates against the external cookie scheme and reads RelayState from AuthenticationProperties.Items["relayState"]
